exposure: SNPs in Fads1, Fads2, Fads3, Elovl2, and Elovl5 genes
cohort: 1050 healthy mother-infant pairs in Beijing, China
finding: Maternal DHA-rich n-3 PUFA supplementation during early and middle pregnancy reduced infant BMI at birth, impacted colostrum PUFA profiles, and showed significant interactions with certain SNPs on PUFA levels.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was adjusted for in the multiple linear regression analysis of the relationship between SNPs and PUFA profiles.
